name: North Carolina
dueDateNotes: North Carolina follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: North Carolina taxes your federal AGI at a flat 3.99% after its standard deduction ($12,750 single / $25,500 married), based on the most recently published amounts.
uniqueFacts: North Carolina's flat income tax rate dropped to 3.99% for 2026 and is scheduled to keep falling in future years.
North Carolina gives a standard deduction of $12,750 for single filers and $25,500 for married couples before applying the flat rate.
North Carolina requires estimated payments once you expect to owe $1,000 or more in state tax.
